name: Old Mother Hiss
place: dungeon steam_grotto (The Hissing Grotto, Steamwood, level 12-14): the end boss at the spring head
_doc: The great salamander that basks in the hot spring the shrine was built over. P1 "Basking": a bite and a tail swipe for the tank, scalding spit, and the four geysers round the pool erupting one after another (stand clear of the one that rumbles). P2 at 55% "Under the Water": she sinks into the spring and will not come up while her brood is alive — kill the wisps (the shield drops with the last one) while boiling waves roll out of the pool. P3 new bar "Steam Burst": she comes up furious; geysers erupt all together, she spits a stack on one player, and the spring throws a huge burst that only the space close by her is safe from. OWNER #51 (2026-10-15): the phase that refilled the health bar is removed; the health bar is the whole fight.
party: Solo: hard in P2 (adds). 2-3: one tank, the rest kill the brood. 5: as designed.

pull: A long hiss from the spring, like every spring on the island at once.
Old Mother Hiss lifts her head out of the water. She is bigger than the shrine.
say.death: Old Mother Hiss sinks back into her spring, and the steam thins for the first time in a hundred years.
say.reset: Old Mother Hiss slides back into her spring to bask.

enrage.say: The spring boils over the whole grotto!

waves.name: Boiling Waves
waves.say: Boiling waves roll out of the spring!

phases.name: Under the Water
phases.say: Mother Hiss sinks under the water. Her brood rises in her place!
phases.shieldDown: The last of the brood pops — Mother Hiss surfaces, gasping!

onEnter.say: Mother Hiss sinks behind a ward of steam. Kill her three wisps to drop it! It fails by itself in 20 seconds.

ward.say: Mother Hiss sinks behind a ward of steam. Kill her three wisps to drop it! It fails by itself in 20 seconds.
ward.fade: The ward fails by itself. No opening this time.
